purpose: A pre-performance protocol for testing a scale-neutral, open-universe China public-market total-return strategy. It does not contain an approved portfolio, allocation or performance claim.

objective.definition: For each predeclared complete rolling five-year out-of-sample cohort, annualised net time-weighted total return is at least 5%.

freeze_before_test: T0 eligibility boundary and dated T2 construction including availability timestamps, exclusions and substitutions.
Candidate-selection inputs, publication lags and deterministic rank/selection rule.
Target weights, cash residual, concentration, reconstitution, drift and risk-event rules.
Order timing, partial/no-fill, stale-order and settlement rules by instrument structure.
Distribution, external-flow and corporate-action accounting convention.
All parameter values, cost schedule, source hierarchy, start/end rule and benchmark definitions.

required_per_decision_date: source reference and immutable archive ID
listing, suspension, price-limit and special-treatment state
point_in_time_universe.rule: A later listing or substitution must be permitted by a predeclared rule; it may not be backfilled after history is observed.

data_hierarchy.use: exchange, regulator, fund-manager, REIT-manager, sovereign and issuer structure/corporate-action/distribution records
raw prices, calendars, halts, limits, delistings, historical membership, liquidity, bid/ask and execution evidence
reconcile selected dates/events; discrepancies are investigated rather than averaged
discovery and sensitivity work only; cannot upgrade a formal replay

total_return_accounting.formula: TWRR = product over subperiods of (V_pre_flow_end / V_post_flow_start) - 1
rules: Use raw unadjusted prices plus an event ledger, or one verified vendor total-return series; never combine an adjusted/total-return series with separately added receipts.
Interest, dividend and fund/REIT distribution enters marked portfolio cash once on its settlement/payment date.
A receipt leaving the portfolio is an external flow at its exact timestamp and is not counted a second time.
Rights, mergers, spin-offs, restructurings, conversions and delistings require source-tested event treatment or block the affected replay.

execution_and_cost_rules: A target observed on D cannot trade before the next permitted venue session under its specific rules.
No-fill or partial-fill states apply to suspension, missing valid quote, limit lock and permitted-volume shortfall. Cash remains unallocated; no synthetic fill or automatic substitute is allowed.
Apply then-effective broker, exchange, registration, transfer, clearing, settlement, tax, spread, adverse-selection and impact assumptions without double deducting fund expenses embedded in NAV.
A unitized proportional-cost replay does not establish lots, minimum fees, capacity or market impact; those require a separately evidenced account-specific feasibility review.
The formal return engine must be scale-neutral and must not accept an integer-lot rule or holder-specific minimum-fee assumption as a substitute for unitized performance.

benchmarks.definition: actual eligible protected-liquidity alternative, net of its own terms and tax
frozen T2/T4 passive strategic comparator using separately predeclared weights/rebalancing

required_reporting: Every predeclared out-of-sample five-year cohort and every complete rolling window, including failures.
Net total return, drawdown, drawdown duration/recovery, volatility, downside deviation, turnover, cost drag and cash drag.
Partial/no-fill days, order age, participation, days-to-liquidate, suspension/limit-lock exposure and settlement shortfalls.
Concentrations by asset, issuer, manager/sponsor, sector, project, geography, tenant/offtaker, refinancing cluster and look-through holdings.
Stress scenarios for equity gap/limit lock/suspension, rate shocks, ETF discount/spread widening, REIT operations/refinancing and correlated liquidity failure.

acceptance_gates.pass: complete authorised point-in-time archive and source manifest
raw-price/event reconciliation, correct costs/settlement and no synthetic fills
all predeclared complete OOS cohorts and windows disclosed; each objective miss retained

current_blockers: No frozen deterministic T2 or T4 portfolio rule exists.
No authorised point-in-time total-return/event archive covers all required domains.
No B0 or B1 comparator is frozen.
No independent candidate-specific risk budget or current execution/suitability packet exists.
The public static price screen failed as a weaker proxy and cannot be repurposed as a formal result.
The existing discrete-lot portfolio engine cannot directly evaluate this scale-neutral objective; a unitized replay layer and cross-asset event adapters are required.
